full_prompt_en: A square digital character illustration groups a lanky cartoon man, a small teal robot, and a white dog against an almost empty warm gray background. The figures rest on a faint ground line near the bottom, leaving wide negative space above and around them. The man stands in the center with his arms folded and feet planted apart. His long neck supports a small angular head with short spiky gray hair, heavy brows, a large rounded nose, a square gray beard, and prominent ears. His eyes glance upward with a skeptical or impatient expression. An open dark olive jacket falls over a tan shirt and very loose khaki trousers; brown straps, a belt, side pouches, and oversized reddish-brown shoes give the outfit its practical comic detail. At his left stands a squat turquoise mechanical companion, built from stacked cylinders, rounded side attachments, and a small top mast. Its half-closed eyes and little mouth turn the machine into an expressive character. At his right, a white dog sits upright with black ears, a large dark oval nose, wide eyes, and a brown collar with a round tag. A tiny bird flies just above the robot, adding a small dark accent in the otherwise open space. Soft shaded color planes give each form modest volume, while crisp but slightly varied outlines keep the design readable. Light is even and diffuse, leaving only small gray contact shadows beneath the shoes, paws, and robot. No readable words appear; a faint signature-like flourish near the lower edge is indistinct. The overall composition is playful and stable, with the tall central silhouette balanced by two compact companions and a restrained palette of olive, tan, teal, and warm red.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字角色插画把一名瘦高卡通男子、一只青绿色小机器人和一条白狗组合在近乎空白的暖灰背景前。角色落在下方一条淡淡的地面线附近，上方和周围留下宽裕负空间。男子站在中央，双臂交叉，双脚分开踏稳。细长脖子上是一颗带棱角的小脑袋，短而竖起的灰发、浓眉、大圆鼻、方形灰胡须和突出的耳朵格外明显。他抬眼向上望，神情怀疑或不耐烦。敞开的深橄榄绿外套罩着棕褐上衣和非常宽松的卡其裤；棕色背带、腰带、侧边小包和夸张的红棕鞋子赋予服装实用又滑稽的细节。左侧是一只矮胖的青绿色机械伙伴，由层叠圆筒、圆润侧部装置和顶上的小杆构成。半闭的眼睛与小嘴让机器也有表情。右侧，一条白狗端坐，黑耳朵、大而深的椭圆鼻子、睁圆的眼睛和带圆牌的棕色项圈清楚可见。机器人上方还有一只小鸟飞过，给大块空处添一枚小深色重音。柔和阴影色面让各个形体有适度体积，清晰而略有变化的轮廓则保持设计易读。光均匀弥散，鞋子、狗爪和机器人下方只有小片灰色接触阴影。画中没有可读字样；下缘附近模糊的签名般曲线无法辨认。整体构图俏皮而稳定，以高大的中央剪影平衡两个紧凑伙伴，配色克制在橄榄绿、棕褐、青绿与暖红之间。
style_prompt_en: The digital illustration uses simplified, exaggerated proportions, clean silhouettes, and softly shaded color blocks. Olive, tan, muted teal, and warm reddish-brown create a modest earthy palette against a largely empty warm gray ground. Facial or mechanical character comes from a few strong geometric shapes and carefully placed small dark accents rather than abundant surface detail. Outlines are crisp but not mechanically uniform, and broad internal planes give gentle volume without photorealistic texture. The tallest mass is balanced by shorter shapes at either side, forming an easy triangular grouping. Diffuse light and slight contact shadows make the grouping feel grounded while preserving the flat, graphic appeal. The overall effect is friendly and humorous, with clear readability and generous negative space carrying much of the design.
style_prompt_zh: 这种数字插画使用简化而夸张的比例、干净剪影和柔和塑形的色块。橄榄绿、棕褐、低饱和青绿与暖红棕在基本空白的暖灰底上形成朴素大地色配色。表情和个性来自少数有力的几何形状与精心安放的小深色重音，而不是大量表面细节。轮廓清晰却不机械均匀，内部宽色面提供温和体积，却没有照片般肌理。最高的色团由两侧较矮形体平衡，构成自然的三角分组。弥散光与轻微接触阴影让组合稳稳落地，同时保留平面图形的吸引力。整体效果友善而幽默，以清晰可读性和充足留白承载大部分设计。
theme_en: A lanky cartoon man posing with a small robot and a white dog
theme_zh: 瘦高卡通男子与小机器人、白狗一同站立
name: Dan Povenmire
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
